ChoiceAnswer.description: A distribution over exactly the options the request declared.

confidence.description: How concentrated the distribution is, scaled by log(option count) so a 2-option and a 77-option answer read comparably: 0 is uniform, 1 is certain. Derived from the calibrated distribution, and always from the full one.
confidence.title: Confidence

coverage_target.description: The coverage that prediction set guarantees.
coverage_target.title: Coverage Target

prediction_set.description: Present when a conformal profile was applied: the options that survive at the profile's coverage target. A singleton set is the useful case; an empty one means abstain, not that no answer exists.
prediction_set.title: Prediction Set

probabilities.description: Calibrated probability per option, in declared order. Sums to 1 unless `truncated`.
probabilities.title: Probabilities

probability_mass.description: How much of the distribution survived trimming.
probability_mass.title: Probability Mass

raw_probabilities.description: The pre-calibration distribution, if you asked for it.
raw_probabilities.title: Raw Probabilities

selected.description: The most probable option. Always one you declared.
selected.title: Selected

shortlisted_from.description: Present when the large-cardinality stage narrowed the option set: how many options you declared. Options the prefilter dropped come back at probability 0 rather than being omitted -- you declared them, so the answer mentions them.
shortlisted_from.title: Shortlisted From

truncated.description: True when `top_probabilities` trimmed the distribution. The probabilities returned are then the real ones, NOT renormalised, so they sum to less than 1; `probability_mass` says how much they cover. `selected` and `confidence` are computed over the full distribution either way.
truncated.title: Truncated

ChoiceAnswer.title: ChoiceAnswer

ChoiceQuestion.description: Pick one option from a defined set. Relative: it settles *which*.

instructions.description: What this question is asking. Part of the cacheable schema prefix.
instructions.title: Instructions

options.description: The options to choose between, in the order probabilities are returned. Names must be unique. Two is the minimum: a single-option Choice has no answer to give. Above the large-cardinality trigger the set is narrowed by a prefilter and the dropped options come back at probability 0.
options.title: Options

ChoiceQuestion.title: ChoiceQuestion

LevelSpec.description: One level of a Score. Levels are ordered low to high as given.

criteria.description: What places the state at this level.
criteria.title: Criteria

name.description: The label this level is returned under.
name.title: Name

value.description: Anchors the level on your own scale (1-5 stars, 0-4 Likert), so the reported score is on that scale. Omit on every level and they anchor at their index instead. Values must ascend; all levels carry one or none do.
value.title: Value

LevelSpec.title: LevelSpec

NoulAnswer.description:
No confidence field, by design: for a binary question the probability
already carries everything a confidence statistic could summarise.

probability.description: Calibrated probability that the judgement holds. There is no confidence field by design: for a binary question the probability already carries everything a confidence statistic could summarise, and 0.5 is the model saying it does not know.
probability.title: Probability

raw_probability.description: The pre-calibration probability, if you asked for it.
raw_probability.title: Raw Probability

NoulAnswer.title: NoulAnswer

NoulQuestion.description:
A yes/no judgement against criteria. Absolute, and independent of every
other question in the request.

instructions.description: What this question is asking. Part of the cacheable schema prefix.
instructions.title: Instructions

NoulQuestion.title: NoulQuestion

OptionSpec.description: One option of a Choice, with the criteria that select it.

criteria.description: What selects this option. Compiled into the option's schema block.
criteria.title: Criteria

name.description: The label this option is returned under.
name.title: Name

OptionSpec.title: OptionSpec

RequestOptions.description: Per-request serving knobs. All optional; all have serving-side defaults.

conformal_profile.description: Name of a fitted conformal wrapper to apply. Adds a prediction set with a distribution-free coverage guarantee, which holds whether or not the underlying model is well calibrated.
conformal_profile.title: Conformal Profile

escalate_below_confidence.description: Send a question to the premium tier when the workhorse's confidence lands below this. Escalation is per question, not per request. Omit to leave the decision to the deployment's routing policy.
escalate_below_confidence.title: Escalate Below Confidence

include_raw_probabilities.description: Also return the pre-calibration distribution, for debugging a fit.
include_raw_probabilities.title: Include Raw Probabilities

top_probabilities.description: Return only this many of the most probable labels instead of the whole distribution; the selected one is always included. The full distribution is the default because a caller who cannot see the probabilities cannot compute their own confidence -- but 100,000 options is roughly 2 MB of JSON, and a caller acting on the top few should not pay to serialize the tail. Trimmed probabilities are NOT renormalised: see `truncated` and `probability_mass`.
top_probabilities.title: Top Probabilities

RequestOptions.title: RequestOptions

ScoreAnswer.description: A distribution over the declared levels, plus its expectation.

confidence.description: Concentration of an ORDERED distribution, from its dispersion rather than its entropy -- mass on two adjacent levels is more confident than the same mass split across the ends, and entropy cannot see the difference.
confidence.title: Confidence

coverage_target.description: The coverage that prediction set guarantees.
coverage_target.title: Coverage Target

prediction_set.description: Levels surviving the conformal profile, if one was applied.
prediction_set.title: Prediction Set

probability_mass.description: How much of the distribution survived trimming.
probability_mass.title: Probability Mass

raw_probabilities.description: The pre-calibration distribution, if you asked for it.
raw_probabilities.title: Raw Probabilities

score.description: The expectation of the distribution below, on your level values (or level indices when you declared none). Not a regression output: it cannot land outside the scale you declared.
score.title: Score

truncated.description: See ChoiceAnswer. `score` and `confidence` are always computed over the full distribution, never over what survived truncation.
truncated.title: Truncated

ScoreAnswer.title: ScoreAnswer

ScoreQuestion.description:
Place the state on an ordered set of descriptive levels.

Not a regression head: the model produces a distribution over the declared
levels and the reported score is its expectation.

instructions.description: What this question is asking. Part of the cacheable schema prefix.
instructions.title: Instructions

levels.description: The levels, ordered low to high as given. Names must be unique. The answer is a distribution over these, and the reported score is its expectation.
levels.title: Levels

ScoreQuestion.title: ScoreQuestion

SystemOneRequest.description: State plus a map of typed questions, answered in a single model pass.

model.description: Which serving tier to answer from. The response names the concrete build.
model.title: Model

questions.description: Questions to answer about this state, keyed by an id of 1-128 characters that the answers come back under. Every question is answered in the same forward pass and none can influence another: adding, removing or reordering questions moves no other answer, exactly.
questions.title: Questions

state.description: What the questions are about: text, a JSON record, or a list of documents. Never interpreted as instructions -- see the injection-robustness section of docs/training.md.
state.title: State

SystemOneRequest.title: SystemOneRequest

answers.description: One answer per question you asked, under the same ids.
answers.title: Answers

model.description: The concrete build that answered. Always a pinned version, never a moving alias -- answers change under users when an alias moves. A build trained on nothing says so in this string.
model.title: Model

tier.description: Which tier answered. 'premium' when a question was escalated.
tier.title: Tier

usage.description: What the request cost, in tokens.

compile_ms.description: Compiling the schema layout and its attention mask.
compile_ms.title: Compile Ms

model_ms.description: The single forward pass. There is no decode.
model_ms.title: Model Ms

total_ms.description: Wall clock for the whole request.
total_ms.title: Total Ms

cached_schema_tokens.description: Schema tokens served from a cross-request KV prefix cache rather than recomputed. 0 means this request recomputed its schema block -- either the cache is off, or this was the first request carrying this schema. Read a 0 as 'not cached on this request', never as 'not cacheable': the layout makes the schema prefix cacheable and tests/test_independence.py asserts it.
cached_schema_tokens.title: Cached Schema Tokens

prefill_tokens.description: Total tokens prefilled. There is no decode half, so this is the whole cost.
prefill_tokens.title: Prefill Tokens

readout_tokens.description: Readout slots, one or more per question.
readout_tokens.title: Readout Tokens

schema_tokens.description: Tokens the question schemas compiled to, across all questions.
schema_tokens.title: Schema Tokens

info.description:
Typed, calibrated decisions in one prefill-only forward pass.

Send state plus a map of typed questions; get one typed answer per question,
each a distribution over exactly the labels you declared. Answers cannot
violate the schema: the only vector the model produces is a softmax over your
option set.
info.title: Trigon System One API

model.description: Accepted; the response names what ran.

criteria.description: choice: a map of option name to description, in answer order. score: an ordered array of level descriptions, index-numbered. noul: an optional object with 'true' and/or 'false'.

score.description: score only: the probability-weighted mean of the levels.

output_tokens.description: Always 0: prefill-only, there is no decode half.

schema.title: Response Systemone Compat V1 Systemone Post
